+def _merge_value(default_value, override_value):
+    if isinstance(default_value, dict) and isinstance(override_value, dict):
+        return _merge_mappings(default_value, override_value)

+        return list(override_value)

+
+def _merge_mappings(defaults, overrides):
+    result = {}
+    for key, value in defaults.items():
+        if isinstance(value, dict):
+            result[key] = _merge_mappings(value, {})

+            result[key] = value

--- a/tests/test_merge_config_regression.py
+++ b/tests/test_merge_config_regression.py
@@ -0,0 +1,72 @@
+from config import merge_config
+
+
+def test_simple_override_preserved():
+    assert merge_config({"a": 1}, {"a": 2, "b": 3}) == {"a": 2, "b": 3}
+    assert merge_config({}, {}) == {}
+
+
+def test_nested_mappings_are_merged_recursively():
+    defaults = {"db": {"host": "localhost", "port": 5432, "opts": {"ssl": False}}}
+    overrides = {"db": {"port": 6543, "opts": {"ssl": True}}}
+    result = merge_config(defaults, overrides)
+    assert result == {
+        "db": {"host": "localhost", "port": 6543, "opts": {"ssl": True}}
+    }
+    assert isinstance(result, dict)
+    assert isinstance(result["db"], dict)
+    assert isinstance(result["db"]["opts"], dict)
+
+
+def test_override_wins_at_leaves():
+    defaults = {"a": {"b": {"c": 1, "d": 2}}}
+    overrides = {"a": {"b": {"c": 99}}}
+    result = merge_config(defaults, overrides)
+    assert result == {"a": {"b": {"c": 99, "d": 2}}}
+
+
+def test_lists_are_replaced_not_concatenated():
+    defaults = {"items": [1, 2, 3], "nested": {"items": ["a"]}}
+    overrides = {"items": [4], "nested": {"items": ["b", "c"]}}
+    result = merge_config(defaults, overrides)
+    assert result == {"items": [4], "nested": {"items": ["b", "c"]}}
+    assert isinstance(result["items"], list)
+    assert isinstance(result["nested"]["items"], list)
+
+
+def test_inputs_are_not_mutated():
+    defaults = {"db": {"host": "localhost", "opts": {"ssl": False}}, "items": [1, 2]}
+    overrides = {"db": {"opts": {"ssl": True}}, "items": [3]}
+    defaults_snapshot = {"db": {"host": "localhost", "opts": {"ssl": False}}, "items": [1, 2]}
+    overrides_snapshot = {"db": {"opts": {"ssl": True}}, "items": [3]}
+    merge_config(defaults, overrides)
+    assert defaults == defaults_snapshot
+    assert overrides == overrides_snapshot
+
+
+def test_result_is_independent_of_inputs():
+    defaults = {"db": {"host": "localhost", "opts": {"ssl": False}}, "items": [1, 2]}
+    overrides = {"db": {"opts": {"ssl": True}}, "items": [3]}
+    result = merge_config(defaults, overrides)
+    assert result["db"] is not defaults["db"]
+    assert result["db"] is not overrides["db"]
+    assert result["db"]["opts"] is not defaults["db"]["opts"]
+    assert result["db"]["opts"] is not overrides["db"]["opts"]
+    assert result["items"] is not defaults["items"]
+    assert result["items"] is not overrides["items"]
+    result["db"]["opts"]["ssl"] = "changed"
+    result["items"].append(99)
+    assert defaults["db"]["opts"]["ssl"] is False
+    assert defaults["items"] == [1, 2]
+    assert overrides["db"]["opts"]["ssl"] is True
+    assert overrides["items"] == [3]
+
+
+def test_new_keys_from_overrides_are_independent():
+    defaults = {}
+    overrides = {"db": {"opts": {"ssl": True}}, "items": [1]}
+    result = merge_config(defaults, overrides)
+    assert result == {"db": {"opts": {"ssl": True}}, "items": [1]}
+    assert result["db"] is not overrides["db"]
+    assert result["db"]["opts"] is not overrides["db"]["opts"]
+    assert result["items"] is not overrides["items"]

contract_tests: test_simple_override_preserved: merge_config({"a": 1}, {"a": 2, "b": 3}) == {"a": 2, "b": 3} and merge_config({}, {}) == {} (preserves original simple-override semantics).

test_nested_mappings_are_merged_recursively: merge_config({"db": {"host": "localhost", "port": 5432, "opts": {"ssl": False}}}, {"db": {"port": 6543, "opts": {"ssl": True}}}) == {"db": {"host": "localhost", "port": 6543, "opts": {"ssl": True}}}; result and nested values are dict instances.
test_override_wins_at_leaves: merge_config({"a": {"b": {"c": 1, "d": 2}}}, {"a": {"b": {"c": 99}}}) == {"a": {"b": {"c": 99, "d": 2}}} (override leaf wins, non-overridden leaf preserved).

test_lists_are_replaced_not_concatenated: merge_config({"items": [1, 2, 3], "nested": {"items": ["a"]}}, {"items": [4], "nested": {"items": ["b", "c"]}}) == {"items": [4], "nested": {"items": ["b", "c"]}}; list values are list instances.
test_inputs_are_not_mutated: after merge_config(defaults, overrides), defaults and overrides equal their pre-call snapshots (no mutation of either input).
test_result_is_independent_of_inputs: result nested dicts and lists are not identical objects to any input nested dict/list; mutating result nested values does not change defaults or overrides.
test_new_keys_from_overrides_are_independent: keys present only in overrides are deep-copied into result so result nested dicts/lists are not shared with overrides.

edits.old:
def merge_config(defaults, overrides):
    result = dict(defaults)
    result.update(overrides)
    return result

patches.rationale: The original merge_config performs a shallow dict update, so nested mappings are not merged and nested objects are shared with the inputs. The issue requires a recursive merge where overrides win at leaves, lists are replaced (not concatenated), and the returned structure is independent of both inputs (no shared nested objects, no mutation of inputs). I implement a recursive helper that builds fresh dicts at every level, copies list values into new lists, and leaves other leaf values as-is. The existing simple-override behavior is preserved. New regression tests in a fresh file cover nested merge, leaf override, list replacement, input non-mutation, and output independence.
